subject: POC kickoff — hybrid logistics, load-test window & visitor pass
content:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Price <samuel.price@quantumretail.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Samuel and I compared calendars and wee hoping to lock the POC kickoff workshop for the week of Dec 14–20. Two options that work on our side: Dec 16 (remote only) or Dec 20 (onsite at our SF HQ).

Before we confirm, two quick things:
- If we do onsite (Dec 20) wel need visitor passes pre-registered + a signed site-access form (I attached our standard form).
- Well want a short load-test window during the afternoon (simulate 200 concurrent prompt requests for ~20 minutes). Is that something Redwood can accommodate during the workshop?
- Recording: were OK with internal recording but need written consent from Redwood for training use (or confirm no recordings will be stored long-term).

I attached a high-level POC plan (v1) — its just the agenda and proposed prompt sets. If you can pick a day today/tomorrow wel get the facility booked.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of AI Integrations
QuantumRetail
Attachments: POC-Plan-v1.pdf; site-access-form.pdf

----
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Elena — great to hear, thanks for the materials. Dec 20 onsite works best for our engineering leads (weve got a few folks traveling that week). We can do the afternoons load test.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm an arrival window? Wel aim to set up the lab and AV an hour before the first session.
- For recording consent: Redwood policy requires written confirmation about retention and downstream use. If QuantumRetail is only using the recording internally (no model training), we can sign off; if you need Redwood to store recordings longer than 90 days or use them for product training, thats a legal conversation.
- AV: Do you have a room with HDMI + meeting-room camera that supports gallery recording? If not, we can bring a small conference camera but need a table and projector.

Il loop in Dev to confirm load profile and prompt routing requirements so we can size the burst accordingly.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Adding logistics notes from ops side:
- If Dec 20 is final, facilities usually requires the visitor list 48h in advance for badges. Wel need full names + company + DOB (or last 4 SSN) for local security — Elena, can you confirm how your visitor badges are normally handled?
- Hybrid option: Meeting Room B (capacity 12) has integrated AV and an overhead camera; Meeting Room C is bigger but needs external camera.
- Please confirm whether QuantumRetail will allow screen recording on their network (some customer nets block streaming).

I can propose a 13:00–17:00 window for the working session with a 15:30 load-test slot (15 minutes warm-up + 20 minutes full load).

-M

----
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Elena, Logan —
We can run the 200-concurrent prompt test as requested. Quick technical notes:
- Test plan: 15:30–16:05 local time, 5-minute ramp, 20-minute sustained, 5-minute cool-down. We'll use a mix of short and long prompts (80% < 80 tokens, 20% ~ 400 tokens) to model your expected workload.
- Routing: during the load test we'll route to our dedicated higher-throughput instance to preserve general availability; after the test we'll switch back to the standard host.
- Sample prompts: please add 8–10 representative prompts to the shared Drive folder so we can include them in the script.
- Wel need an endpoint IP allowlist or a temporary VPN tunnel if facility has a strict network policy.

Il attach a short runbook and the test JSON payloads to the Drive folder (link below).

—Dev

----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Price <samuel.price@quantumretail.com>, Facilities Scheduler <facilities@hq.quantumretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Thanks everyone — were locking Dec 20, 13:00–17:00 onsite at QuantumRetail SF HQ, Meeting Room B.

Actions Im taking now:
- I uploaded the signed site-access-form.pdf (attached) and sent the visitor list to facilities (they confirmed they have received it).
- I placed 8 representative prompts into the shared Drive folder (link above).
- Facilities confirmed Meeting Room B has integrated AV and will enable network allowlist for Redwoods test IPs for the afternoon.
- I created a calendar event and shared it: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=quantumretail-poc-kickoff

On recording: we are confirming internal policy — likely OK for the meeting to be recorded for internal QA; we will include the written consent note in the calendar invite description.

See you on Dec 20,
Elena

----
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Facilities Scheduler <facilities@hq.quantumretail.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuantumRetail POC kickoff — proposed dates and quick logistics questions

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Elena. A couple follow-ups before we close the loop:
- Logan -> Facilities: please confirm table layout (we prefer a demo table near the projector and a separate laptop table for load generators).
- Elena -> please confirm final attendee list (for badges) by EOD Friday the 18th.
- Recording consent: Tessa, can you produce the short consent text we should add to the calendar invite? Wel add it to the event and ask attendees to acknowledge on arrival.
- Dev: please share the test IPs and small runbook link in the invite and double-check that the allowlist window matches 15:20–16:10.

Il update the POC-Plan-v1.pdf with the finalized schedule and re-upload to the Drive folder.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: POC-Plan-v1.pdf; site-access-form.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1POC-QuantumRetail
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=quantumretail-poc-kickoff
